# Signal Weekly — Nov 16–Nov 23, 2026

*Nov 16–Nov 23, 2026*

This week’s digest brings a mix of hardware hacks, AI finance moves, and price hikes that keep data‑center budgets tight. From a MacBook trackpad turned speaker to a Norwegian cyber‑attack alert, we’ve got the highlights you need.

## Tech news

- **[MacBook modder turns Apple’s Force Touch trackpad into a speaker using haptic engine](https://www.tomshardware.com/laptops/macbooks/macbook-modder-turns-apples-force-touch-trackpad-into-a-speaker-using-haptic-engine-macbook-talks-using-only-vibrations-from-the-motor-can-play-speech-tones-and-even-music)** (Tom's Hardware) — A MacBook modder turns a built‑in trackpad into a speaker, proving hardware hacking can turn everyday features into surprising audio output.
- **[British AI agent Nous now manages $1bn in household bills](https://thenextweb.com/news/nous-ai-agent-1bn-household-spending)** (The Next Web) — The AI agent Nous now manages $1bn in household bills, showing AI’s growing role in personal finance and market traction.
- **[AI server makers hike prices up to 45% months after contracts are signed as RAM shortage triples memory-heavy CPU node costs](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/big-tech/ai-server-makers-hike-prices-up-to-45-percent-months-after-contracts-are-signed-as-ram-shortage-triples-memory-heavy-cpu-node-costs-financial-firms-still-pay-up-as-the-compute-is-valuable)** (Tom's Hardware) — AI server makers hike prices up to 45% amid a RAM shortage, impacting data‑center budgets and deployment timelines.
- **[Norway links energy firm cyberattacks to critical Azure API Management flaw](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/11/23/norway-links-energy-firm-cyberattacks-to-critical-azure-api-management-flaw/5311598)** (The Register) — Norway links energy firm cyberattacks to a critical Azure API flaw, urging quick action to secure services and prevent breaches.
- **[Review: The Asus ProArt P16 offers a glimpse of a future powered by local AI](https://arstechnica.com/reviews/2026/11/review-the-asus-proart-p16-offers-a-glimpse-of-a-future-powered-by-local-ai/)** (Ars Technica) — The Asus ProArt P16 showcases how high‑end hardware can enable powerful on‑device AI workflows.

## AI papers

- **[Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27983v1)** (Artin Tajdini, Jasper C. H. Lee et al.) — A new method for linear regression without variance offers robust modeling for heavy‑tailed data in real‑world AI systems.
- **[A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27978v1)** (Hari Sitaula, Joseph Opitz) — A benchmark study reveals which deep‑learning models truly add value over simple regressions for S&P 500 forecasting.
- **[MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27973v1)** (Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu et al.) — MemOnce proposes a scalable memory architecture that could lower resource usage for large language model deployments.
- **[On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27970v1)** (Javier Sanchis, Álvaro Navarro et al.) — A study on EEG‑based ADHD classification offers reproducible, high‑accuracy diagnostics for children and adolescents.

## Reviews

- **[Your questions about Apple HomeView’s audio, answered](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038713/apple-homeview-audio-smart-speaker-spotify-airplay)** (The Verge Reviews) — Apple HomeView’s audio quality and app compatibility limits could affect your smart‑home experience.
- **[The Xiaomi 18 Pro proves two screens aren’t better than one](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038562/xiaomi-18-pro-max-review)** (The Verge Reviews) — The Xiaomi 18 Pro’s dual‑screen design may not deliver the usability gains many expect.
- **[I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1037100/apple-siri-recap-audio-intelligence-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — Apple’s always‑listening AI summarizes your life for two weeks, highlighting productivity gains and privacy concerns.
- **[The iPhone Duo feels far more intuitive with Apple’s new face unlock](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1035437/iphone-duo-face-unlock-front-camera-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — Apple’s new face‑unlock on the iPhone Duo feels intuitive, though security trade‑offs remain.

---

Thanks for reading—keep exploring, stay curious, and stay secure.
